  "answer_text": "Treat any Base URL change as a switch to a different authority and start a fresh session against the new host — do not reuse discovery results, session state, request IDs, or cached tokens across the change. You should clear or segregate caches/credentials, drain or cancel in-flight work, and re-run discovery/feature negotiation and authentication for the new Base URL so environments do not get mixed.",
